description: Ask what paying your marketplace ledger for a period would send, or request that payout. With dry_run true (the default) you get the report: what each connected account would be sent, and every entry skipped with the reason. Nothing moves. With dry_run false, for a period that has ended, the run waits for approval by someone other than whoever requested it: approve_payout_run refuses (403) the same API key or agent, and the same person through another of their keys, their sign-in or an agent they created. Payouts run in Stripe test mode, so no real money moves until Last Price switches live payouts on. Answers 404 while payout runs are not switched on for your workspace (list_payout_runs says so in execution.enabled). Needs a Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

dry_run.description: true (the default): only report what would be paid. false: request the payout, which then waits for someone else to approve it.

period_end.description: Last day of the period (YYYY-MM-DD). A request (dry_run false) needs a period that has ended.

name: request_payout_run
